title: Minimal Metric Counter with Progress Bar
summary: A minimalist white-background metric card animates a numerical counter from 0 to 22 alongside a filling blue progress bar, followed by an extended hold and a fade to white.

narrative.observation: A single metric displays goal progress via a numeric count-up and encouraging status copy before resting.
narrative.limitation: No broader product context or interface surrounds the text block.

editing.observation: Single continuous take fading in from solid white around 0.3s and fading out to white around 6.8s.
editing.limitation: Exact fade start and end frames are subtle against the light background.

product_presentation.observation: Apparent dashboard widget or goal-tracking statistic displayed in the right third of the frame.
product_presentation.limitation: Rendered without UI containers, cards, or navigation chrome.

motion.observation: The large metric number rapidly ticks up from 0 to 22 while a blue horizontal progress bar simultaneously fills from left to right.
motion.limitation: Frame rate sampling rate limits tracking exact numerical increments.

graphics.observation: Clean typography hierarchy: oversized black digits, medium gray header, blue accent progress bar, and small lighter subtext.

ideas.title: Synchronized Numerical and Linear Progress Reveal
ideas.observed_sequence: A bold metric counts up from 0 to 22 over roughly 1.4 seconds while a thin accent bar fills proportionally beneath it.
ideas.communication_problem: Conveying progress or achievement dynamically without overwhelming users with complex visual assets.
ideas.creative_mechanism: Dual representation of metric growth—rapidly updating typography paired with linear visual filling to reinforce completion momentum.
ideas.adaptation_example: In an onboarding completion screen, count onboarding steps completed from 0 to 5 while filling a green line indicator.
ideas.do_not_transfer: Extremely long static hold (over 4 seconds) on a single unchanged number.
ideas.interpretation_caveat: Target maximum value is not explicitly stated in text, only visually implied by the bar's endpoint.

uncertainties: Whether the element is intended as standalone motion graphics or an isolated crop of a larger dashboard interface.
